reading.title: Scorpio Sun Squares Jupiter While Neptune Opposes the Sibly MC
overview: The Sun at 26° Scorpio squares Jupiter at 26° Leo with an orb of 0.48° while Mars at 27° Leo conjoins Jupiter at 0.59°. Venus rules Libra at 23° and the Moon at 0° Pisces moves toward a trine with Mercury at 7° Scorpio. Saturn remains retrograde in its fall at 8° Aries, Uranus and Neptune are retrograde, and Pluto at 3° Aquarius is out of bounds.

Mundane tradition reads the Sun-Jupiter square and Mars-Jupiter conjunction as periods when leaders pursue expansive aims that risk overreach. The Uranus-Pluto trine at 0.69° and Neptune-Pluto sextile at 1.53° point to slow structural shifts in collective assumptions. The last new moon at Scorpio 17° fell in the third house for the United States and the twelfth house for Russia, Ukraine and Israel.

Transits to national angles include Neptune opposing the Sibly MC at 0.92° and Mars opposing the Sibly Moon at 0.56°. Pluto conjoins the Chinese Moon at 0.26° and the Chinese ASC at 1.77°. Jupiter conjoins Ukraine's Mercury at 0.0° and Saturn squares Taiwan's Sun at 0.99°.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC at 0.92° and Mars opposes the Sibly Moon at 0.56°. These transits coincide with reported US-Iran exchanges and diplomatic recruitment activity. The new moon placed the lunation in the third house.

Jupiter conjoins natal Mercury at 0.0° and Mars conjoins natal Mercury at 0.59°. Pluto conjoins natal Saturn at 1.8°. Today's reporting on long-range strikes and US policy choices overlaps these degrees.
Pluto conjoins the natal Moon at 0.26° and the ASC at 1.77°. The Sun conjoins the MC at 1.83°. The new moon fell in the eighth house.
Saturn squares the natal Sun at 0.99° and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter at 0.55°. Jupiter squares natal Venus at 0.24°. The new moon fell in the eighth house.
Pluto opposes the natal Moon at 1.03° and the Sun trines the MC at 0.49°. The new moon fell in the twelfth house.
Jupiter squares the MC at 0.56° and the Sun opposes the MC at 0.08°. Uranus squares natal Venus at 0.02°. The new moon fell in the eleventh house.

reading.lore_and_intel: Sun square Jupiter and Mars conjunction Jupiter overlap with reporting on diplomatic recruitment and Ukrainian strikes on rear-area targets; Uranus trine Pluto and Uranus sextile Neptune overlap with Taiwan election markets and Ukrainian multi-stage operations. Venus sextile Jupiter overlaps with Deutsche Bank leaks and measles data. Mercury square Pluto overlaps with an Army Chief nomination. Neptune opposition to the Sibly MC overlaps with reported US-Iran strikes. No computed position or aspect is linked to any unreported event in the supplied intel.

watch.note: Jupiter stations retrograde and Neptune stations direct

reading.the_test: Records show Mars afflicted versus Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israel alerts and Russian losses performed no better than chance. Full moons versus the same alerts also performed no better than chance. Eclipses and new or full moons versus magnitude 6+ earthquakes worldwide likewise showed no improvement over chance.
